title: Enrichment
description: Add context to events inside the pipeline, before routing and detection.

egress.warning_one: {{count}} source sends indicators from your environment to an external service. Requires per-organization opt-in.
egress.warning_other: {{count}} sources send indicators from your environment to external services. They require per-organization opt-in.

tables.emptyDescription: Customer tables (CMDB, network plan, allowlist) are matched by exact key or by the most specific CIDR prefix.

form.name: Name
form.nameRequired: Enter a name for the table.
form.matchModeExactHint: Compares the event's key by exact equality.
form.matchModeCidrHint: Compares an IP by the MOST SPECIFIC network prefix that contains it.
form.organizationRequired: Select an organization. There is no global enrichment table.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete table
deleteConfirm.description: This removes "{{name}}" and its whole version history. Only possible if no policy references it.

versions.title: Versions of {{name}}
versions.rowsHelperExact: Object {key: {field: value}}. The key is compared by exact equality.
versions.rowsHelperCidr: Object {cidr: {field: value}}. Each key must be an IP or a CIDR range (e.g. 10.0.5.0/24).
versions.mustBeObject: The content must be an object {key: {field: value}}, not a list.
versions.invalidJson: Invalid JSON. Check commas and braces.

policies.emptyDescription: A policy defines which enrichment rules run and where the result is written.

form.name: Name
form.nameRequired: Enter a name for the policy.
form.organizationRequired: Select an organization. There is no global enrichment policy.

versions.title: Versions of {{name}}
versions.enabledNow: Policy active. It applies to new events for this organization.
versions.rulesEmpty: Add at least one rule before publishing.
versions.tableHint: Only used by table enrichers (table_exact, table_cidr).
versions.keySourceHint: Path inside the normalized event, e.g.: normalized.src_endpoint.ip
versions.tagsHint: Written to _centralops.enrichment_tags, usable in other rules' conditions and in routes. Enter or comma adds one.

dryRun.title: Test before publishing
dryRun.hint: Applies the rules above to a sample event, without publishing anything or touching real traffic.
dryRun.tablesHint: {rule_id: {key: {field: value}}}. Tests without publishing the real table.
dryRun.needsRules: Add at least one rule before testing.
dryRun.invalidSample: The sample event is not valid JSON.
dryRun.invalidTables: The simulated tables are not valid JSON.

versions.sourceRequired: Required: this enricher needs a credential.
versions.sourceHint: The credential lives in the source, never in the rule.
versions.replaceWarning: Publishing replaces every rule in the policy. The editor opens with the current version's rules, so keep the ones that should stay in effect.
versions.onMissNeedsDefault: Set a default value on an output to use this option.

when.label: When to apply
when.hint: One condition per rule. For alternatives, chain rules: one tags the event, the next reacts to that tag.
when.in: If the field is in the list
when.hasTag: If the event already has the tag
when.lacksTag: If the event does NOT have the tag
when.tagRequired: Pick at least one tag, otherwise the condition will not compile.
when.emptySource: Fill in the field path. Without it the condition compiles but never matches, and the rule vanishes from the panels as if no event had the field.
when.emptyValues: Add at least one value. An empty list compiles but never matches, so the rule never runs.

versions.cannotChain: This rule already has another condition. A gate has a single key, so chaining would erase the condition you wrote.
versions.keySourceHintMapped: Suggestions come from the fields this organization's active mappings actually write. A path outside the list compiles but never matches.

sources.emptyDescription: A source is an instance of an enricher in this organization: the endpoint and credential it runs with here.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete source
deleteConfirm.description: This removes "{{name}}" and its credential. Only possible if no policy references it.

form.name: Name
form.nameRequired: Enter a name for the source.
form.nameImmutable: The name cannot change after creation, because rules reference it.
form.organizationRequired: Select an organization. The credential is bound to it.
form.secretHint: Sent once and encrypted by the server; the API never returns it. Required: {{names}}.
form.sharedOrgsHint: The source always serves the owning organization. Check the children that should also use this credential. Sharing requires the Enterprise edition.

test.title: Test connection
test.hint: Queries the real source with the stored credential, in reduced mode. Publishes nothing.

scope.title: You are seeing one organization
scope.body: An organization-scoped token only sees its own. To follow several customers in a SOC, use a global-scoped token or the Enterprise edition, which enables the subtree view.

execution.emptyBody: The log appears after the first collection cycle with an active policy. If you already enabled one and nothing shows up, check that the policy is enabled and that an integration is collecting.
execution.hitRateHint: A falling match rate with working queries points to a change in the source data format, not the credential.
execution.noRules: No enabled policy with a published version in this organization.
execution.silent: Did not run in this window
execution.queriesHint: One record per table load (one per cycle) and per remote query (one per batch). There is no per-event record.
execution.noFailures: No failures. The query path is up.
execution.retentionTitle: The log keeps the last 200 queries per organization, for 24 hours
execution.retentionBody: It is for immediate diagnosis. For long-term history, use the metrics exported through OpenTelemetry.
execution.hitRateHintUnanswered: Some queries went unanswered in this window: the match rate is diluted by a credential, network or budget failure, not by a change in the data. Check Queries before touching the rules.
